ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast characterized by a dominant light gray/white pixel intensity (mid-to-high) across the lobes, contrasted with a localized concentration of low-intensity black pixels at the central peduncle attachment and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive, dense salt-and-pepper mottling covers the majority of both lobes. A large, contiguous irregular dark blob is positioned centrally, surrounding the median notch. High-intensity white patches are notably larger and more contiguous on the distal portion of the right lobe compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations with a relatively uniform boundary. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced, irregular topographical variations with several distinct moderate-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a relatively linear sweep tapering to a blunt tip. The right lobe displays a more pronounced convex curve on its upper edge, tapering towards an elevated, sharper distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A distinct cluster of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) is detected within the dark pigment region at the base of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the proximal inner surface of the right lobe, cutting through the natural mottling pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear vertical scarring on the lower right lobe and an irregular, large dark pigmentation patch centered at the fluke base/notch junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and distribution of the salt-and-pepper stippling across the entire visible ventral surface constitutes a unique visual identifier.
